note: Both sets are faithful and accurate on the shared claims, with quotes that match the page and correct Region 3 conditions on the generator-torque relationship. Set A additionally captures the definition of IGen (generator inertia relative to the high-speed shaft), which Set B omits, so A covers the symbol list more completely. Neither set misreads or invents anything; both repeat the θ/blade-pitch-angle fact under two names. Because the only difference is one correct claim present in A and missing in B, A is slightly better.
remarks: Both sets state the θ definition twice (as 'θ | definition' and as 'blade-pitch angle | symbol | θ'), a harmless duplication. Both also leave out other symbol definitions on the page (Ω0 rated low-speed shaft speed, Ω low-speed shaft rotational speed, t simulation time, and the KP/KI/KD PID gains), so the omission is symmetric except for IGen.
